description: Backend curation foundation + build prerequisite. Add iconoir-react so the frontend builds at all, then add all backend curation logic in backend-deploy/index.mjs: pure helpers (config normalizer, uploads-fetch, item mapper, featured resolver, ISO-duration parser) and the four new endpoints (GET /youtube/playlists, GET/POST /youtube/curation, GET /youtube/sections), persisting config in T.VIDEO_TAGS under key '__YT_CURATION__'. youtubeListVideos/youtubeSearch/youtubeSmartSearch external behavior stays unchanged. Independent of FEAT-002/003 but must come first: the endpoints are the contract the DataContext and pages consume, and iconoir-react must exist before any frontend build can be green.
steps: In frontend/package.json add "iconoir-react" to dependencies, then run `npm install` inside frontend/ (lets package-lock.json pin the resolved version). This fixes the already-broken build (HomePage.tsx line 6 imports iconoir-react).

In backend-deploy/index.mjs near the YouTube helpers (~1792) add `const YT_CURATION_KEY = '__YT_CURATION__';` and `async function getCurationConfig()` using GetCommand on T.VIDEO_TAGS key __YT_CURATION__; always return a normalized object { selectedPlaylists: string[], hiddenVideoIds: string[], featuredVideoId: string|null } with safe defaults (missing item or wrong-typed field -> default; drop non-string array entries); on a DynamoDB read error, console.error and return the defaults (do not throw).

Extract `function mapPlaylistItems(items)` = the exact projection + `.filter(v => v.title !== 'Deleted video' && v.title !== 'Private video')` currently inlined in youtubeListVideos (fields id,title,description,thumbnail with the SAME chained thumbnails fallback maxres->standard->high->medium->default->'' ,publishedAt,privacy,channelTitle). Refactor youtubeListVideos to call mapPlaylistItems(data.items) with NO change to its external behavior (still /youtube/videos handler: single page, min(limit||20,50), same guards, same res(200,{videos,totalResults,nextPageToken,prevPageToken})).

Add `async function fetchUploadsPool(token, { maxPages = 2, maxResults = 50 } = {})` that paginates playlistItems?part=snippet,status,contentDetails&playlistId=${YT_UPLOADS_PLAYLIST}&maxResults=<n> up to maxPages, throws on data.error, and returns the mapPlaylistItems array. No res() envelope, no auth guard.

Add pure helpers `function parseIsoDurationToSeconds(iso)` (regex PT(?:(\d+)H)?(?:(\d+)M)?(?:(\d+)S)?, hours*3600+min*60+sec, 0 if no match) and `function resolveFeatured(config, pool)` = pool.find(v=>v.id===config.featuredVideoId) ?? [...pool].sort((a,b)=>String(b.publishedAt).localeCompare(String(a.publishedAt)))[0] ?? null.

Add handler `async function youtubeListChannelPlaylists(query, user)`: guard !user->res(401,{message:'Nao autenticado'}), !YT_REFRESH_TOKEN->res(500,{message:'YouTube nao configurado.'}); paginate playlists?part=snippet,contentDetails&channelId=${YT_CHANNEL_ID}&maxResults=50; on data.error -> res(400,{message:'Erro YouTube',error:data.error.message}); map each to {id,title,description,thumbnail(chained fallback or ''),itemCount(contentDetails.itemCount||0),selected,order} using getCurationConfig() to mark selected (in selectedPlaylists) and order (index or null). try/catch -> console.error + res(500,...).
Add `async function ytCurationGet(user)`: !user->res(401); return res(200, await getCurationConfig()).

Add `async function ytCurationSave(data, user)`: (!user||!isAdmin(user))->res(403,{message:'Apenas administradores podem gerenciar a curadoria de vídeos.'}); partial merge over the current item (only apply fields present in body). Validate: selectedPlaylists if present must be Array else res(400,{message:'selectedPlaylists deve ser uma lista.'}), drop non-string/empty entries, if >200 res(400,{message:'Número de playlists selecionadas excede o limite (200).'}); hiddenVideoIds Array of strings, drop non-strings, cap 5000; featuredVideoId must be string|null (empty string -> null) else res(400,...). PutCommand item { videoId:'__YT_CURATION__', selectedPlaylists, hiddenVideoIds, featuredVideoId, updatedAt:new Date().toISOString(), updatedBy:user.id }; on write error res(500,{message:'Erro ao salvar curadoria',error:err.message}). Return res(200, normalized resulting config).

Add `async function youtubeCuratedSections(query, user)`: !user->res(401), !YT_REFRESH_TOKEN->res(500,...); read config; `const includeHidden = isAdmin(user) && query.includeHidden === '1';`. If selectedPlaylists empty (fallback): videos = await fetchUploadsPool(token,{maxPages:2,maxResults:50}); if !includeHidden filter out hiddenVideoIds (Set), else annotate each with hidden:true/false; return res(200,{fallback:true,sections:[{playlistId:null,title:null,videos}]}). Else (curated): one playlists?part=snippet&id=<csv of selected> call for titles (placeholder title = playlistId when missing/failed); for each playlistId in array order paginate playlistItems?part=snippet,status,contentDetails&playlistId=<id>&maxResults=50 with maxPages=4, map via mapPlaylistItems, per-playlist data.error -> console.error and skip that section; if !includeHidden filter hidden else annotate; return res(200,{fallback:false,sections:[...]}). When includeHidden: collect all video ids, batch videos?part=contentDetails&id=<=50 csv per call, set likelyShort = secs>0 && secs<=60 via parseIsoDurationToSeconds (batch data.error -> console.error, likelyShort=false for that batch; missing contentDetails -> likelyShort=false). Wrap in try/catch -> console.error + res(500,...).

Register the four routes in the `// ---- YouTube ----` block (after line 216, before `// ---- Comments ----`): `if (path === '/youtube/playlists' && method === 'GET') return await youtubeListChannelPlaylists(qs(event), getUserFromToken(event));` ; `if (path === '/youtube/curation' && method === 'GET') return await ytCurationGet(getUserFromToken(event));` ; `if (path === '/youtube/curation' && method === 'POST') return await ytCurationSave(body(event), getUserFromToken(event));` ; `if (path === '/youtube/sections' && method === 'GET') return await youtubeCuratedSections(qs(event), getUserFromToken(event));`
acceptance_criteria: iconoir-react appears in frontend/package.json dependencies and is installed (frontend/package-lock.json updated).
Running `cd frontend && npx tsc -b` exits 0 and `npm run build` exits 0 (build is no longer broken).
Running `node --check backend-deploy/index.mjs` from the worktree root exits 0.

The four routes (/youtube/playlists GET, /youtube/curation GET, /youtube/curation POST, /youtube/sections GET) are present in the route block; youtubeListVideos/youtubeSearch/youtubeSmartSearch signatures and return shapes are unchanged.

Config persists via a single T.VIDEO_TAGS item keyed videoId='__YT_CURATION__'; getCurationConfig never returns undefined and defaults to {selectedPlaylists:[],hiddenVideoIds:[],featuredVideoId:null}.
includeHidden is honored only when isAdmin(user) && query.includeHidden === '1'; public mode filters hiddenVideoIds in BOTH curated and fallback modes.
verification: node -e "..." smoke test of pure helpers: parseIsoDurationToSeconds('PT48S')===48, parseIsoDurationToSeconds('PT1M3S')===63, resolveFeatured({featuredVideoId:'b'},[{id:'a',publishedAt:'1'},{id:'b',publishedAt:'2'}]).id==='b', and resolveFeatured({featuredVideoId:'zzz'},[{id:'a',publishedAt:'1'},{id:'b',publishedAt:'2'}]).id==='b' (newest by publishedAt)
findings:
FEAT-001 implemented. Backend (backend-deploy/index.mjs):
- Added const YT_CURATION_KEY = '__YT_CURATION__'.
- getCurationConfig() -> always returns normalized { selectedPlaylists: string[], hiddenVideoIds: string[], featuredVideoId: string|null }; DynamoDB read error -> console.error + defaults (no throw).
- mapPlaylistItems(items) extracted from youtubeListVideos (same projection: id,title,description,thumbnail [maxres->standard->high->medium->default->''],publishedAt,privacy,channelTitle + filter 'Deleted video'/'Private video'). youtubeListVideos external behavior UNCHANGED (still /youtube/videos, single page, min(limit||20,50), same res shape).
- fetchUploadsPool(token,{maxPages=2,maxResults=50}) paginates uploads playlist, throws on data.error, returns mapped array (no res, no auth).
- parseIsoDurationToSeconds(iso), resolveFeatured(config,pool).
- Handlers: youtubeListChannelPlaylists(query,user), ytCurationGet(user), ytCurationSave(data,user) [partial merge + validation], youtubeCuratedSections(query,user) + private helper annotateLikelyShorts(token,sections).

EXACT CONTRACT for FEAT-002/003 (endpoints + response shapes):
- GET /youtube/playlists (auth required) -> { playlists: [{ id, title, description, thumbnail, itemCount, selected:boolean, order:number|null }] }. order = index within selectedPlaylists or null.
- GET /youtube/curation (auth required) -> { selectedPlaylists: string[], hiddenVideoIds: string[], featuredVideoId: string|null }.
- POST /youtube/curation (admin only, else 403 'Apenas administradores podem gerenciar a curadoria de vídeos.') -> partial merge; body fields all optional: selectedPlaylists (Array<string>, non-string/empty dropped, max 200), hiddenVideoIds (Array<string>, dropped non-strings, cap 5000), featuredVideoId (string | null; '' -> null). Returns the normalized resulting config { selectedPlaylists, hiddenVideoIds, featuredVideoId }.
- GET /youtube/sections (auth required). Query param includeHidden='1' honored ONLY when isAdmin(user). Fallback (no selectedPlaylists): { fallback:true, sections:[{ playlistId:null, title:null, videos:[...] }] }. Curated: { fallback:false, sections:[{ playlistId, title, videos:[...] }] } in selectedPlaylists order; a playlist whose fetch errors is skipped. Public mode filters hiddenVideoIds in BOTH modes; admin+includeHidden annotates each video with hidden:boolean and likelyShort:boolean (likelyShort = 0 < durationSecs <= 60). Video shape = {id,title,description,thumbnail,publishedAt,privacy,channelTitle} (+ hidden/likelyShort when includeHidden).
- Persistence: single T.VIDEO_TAGS item keyed videoId='__YT_CURATION__' with { selectedPlaylists, hiddenVideoIds, featuredVideoId, updatedAt, updatedBy:user.id }.

VERIFICATION: node --check backend-deploy/index.mjs exits 0. Pure-helper smoke test (parseIsoDurationToSeconds 'PT48S'=48, 'PT1M3S'=63; resolveFeatured featured-match and newest-by-publishedAt fallback) all PASS.

DEVIATION / PRE-EXISTING BLOCKER for the frontend build (NOT caused by FEAT-001): `cd frontend && npx tsc -b` fails with 2 errors in frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx:12 — Property 'getFolderCover' and 'getDropboxThumbnailBatch' do not exist on DataContextType. Root cause: the committed HomePage redesign (HEAD 134d41e) references these two DataContext methods, but this worktree branch's frontend/src/contexts/DataContext.tsx never had them added (last touched at aeacb99 on a different lineage). They DO exist in the parent workspace DataContext.tsx and also depend on backend endpoints /dropbox/thumbnail-batch and /dropbox/folder-cover, which are ALSO absent from this worktree's backend-deploy/index.mjs. iconoir-react itself resolved to 7.12.1 and introduces zero errors; the iconoir import at HomePage.tsx line 6 now compiles. FEAT-003 (DataContext + pages) must add getFolderCover + getDropboxThumbnailBatch to DataContext.tsx (and the matching Dropbox backend endpoints) to make `npm run build` green; until then `npm run build` is NOT green in this worktree. This cross-feature sync gap was escalated to the caller.

RESOLUTION (per caller decision, folded into this step): ported the missing Dropbox thumbnail/cover subsystem from the parent workspace (production code) into the worktree so the build is green. Changes:
- Backend backend-deploy/index.mjs: added `import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'`; added the S3 thumb-cache layer (THUMB_IMAGE_EXTS, THUMB_SIZES, THUMBS_CDN_URL, THUMBS_PREFIX, thumbS3Key, thumbUrlForKey, thumbExistsInS3, storeThumbInS3) and two handlers dropboxThumbnailBatch(data,user) [POST /dropbox/thumbnail-batch -> { thumbs: Record<path,url> }] and dropboxFolderCover(query,user) [GET /dropbox/folder-cover?path= -> { path, cover: string|null, coverLower? }]; registered both routes in the /dropbox block. The singular dropboxThumbnail + fetchDropboxThumb were intentionally NOT ported (nothing in the worktree references them). Deps UPLOAD_BUCKET, getSignedUrl, GetObjectCommand/PutObjectCommand, s3, getDropboxToken, dbxHeaders, DROPBOX_NAMESPACE_ID already existed in the worktree.
- Frontend DataContext.tsx: added getDropboxThumbnailBatch(paths,size?) and getFolderCover(path) (type signatures + useCallback impls copied from parent + exported in provider value).
After this, cd frontend && npx tsc -b exits 0, npm run build exits 0, node --check backend-deploy/index.mjs exits 0. BLOCKER RESOLVED.
